Discrete profile: 5.03% remapped, mean drift 0.95527px, max45px; continuous minimax: 14.33% remapped, mean drift1.48841px, max22.5px. Two semantic two-speed maps were previewed. Preserving sky moves castle/wall and exposes a magenta hole; preserving castle/roof shifts the moon by up to 120.5px. HSCROLL_LINE and coherent BG_A/B ownership remain unimplemented. Tooling validation 2026-09-26: full mugen2sgdk_forge suite 114 passed; six semantic profile tests; compileall and JSON checks pass. Learning capture/audit: 60 lessons, 31 candidates, no canonical promotion.
